passages.title: The food rumor
passages.text: You may have heard the government issued an order to hoard 90 days of food.

food_paste.text: The U.S. government has not told civilians to hoard 90 days of food. In October 2026 a European supermarket refrigeration cyberattack knocked freezers offline. The EU advises households to keep a 72-hour emergency kit. FEMA and ready.gov tell households to keep a 72-hour kit of food and water. Germany recommends keeping several days of shelf-stable food. Stores saw a short run on bottled water after the rumor spread.

source_quality.claim: Germany recommends households keep food for several days.
